facts.business: SMC Credits Limited operates as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing loan assets to corporates and making investments in unlisted entities.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Valuation of investments in unlisted entities determined using latest available audited financial information as at March 31, 2025, as audited financial statements as at March 31, 2026 were not available. Additional shares subscribed during the year recognised at acquisition cost without corresponding fair value remeasurement as at March 31, 2026.

key_risks: Impairment of loan assets to corporates under NBFC business
Valuation uncertainty of investments in unlisted entities due to use of March 31, 2025 data instead of March 31, 2026 data
Additional shares subscribed in investee entities recognised at acquisition cost without fair value remeasurement
